mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, user_id, product, amount, status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{product}, #{amount}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM t_order
